pairs.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:705 The mesh finish export relies on the exporter completing and a simple file-existence check without reading back the exported GLB inside the process to verify scene and mesh contents.

techniques.evidence: scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:705 Exporter returns success and file existence is checked without re-reading the exported GLB file inside the process to verify scenes, meshes, and nodes.
scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:356 Re-shading is explicitly refused when the source mesh carries custom split normals, logging that custom normals override crease angle.
scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:326 Verifies actual mesh modification because QuadriFlow silently no-ops and returns FINISHED on non-manifold input.
scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:551 BAKE_TYPES natively supports only shape-derivable channels (normal, ao, diffuse, roughness) and deliberately excludes metallic.

scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:384 Detects presence of authored UV layers before packing existing islands, reporting UV_MODE_FALLBACK and falling back to smart unwrap only when no authored UVs exist.
scripts/visual-gen/pof_mesh_finish.py:678 The unwrap operation is run strictly on the decimated low-poly copy (low) after the decimation pass has completed.
